urdu.name: نعمہ
urdu.long_meaning: Nimah (نعمہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم نعمہ، نعمت ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: نعمه

faq.question: What does Nimah mean?
faq.answer: Nimah is associated with the Arabic form نِعْمَة, whose core sense is nimah; blessing, favour.

faq.question: What is the origin of Nimah?
faq.answer: Nimah is associated with Arabic. Nimah is Arabic نِعْمَة (Niʿma) 'blessing, favour', from the root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m). The source gloss 'Grace, Beauty' is broadly consistent. Same name as neima.

faq.question: Is Nimah an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form نِعْمَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Nimah an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Nimah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
